session.version_stamp_note: Prefer stamp in thread/session title or as a single short line above items if the bot needs a version anchor. Never restore old how-to / marks / out-of-scope top or bottom blocks.

items.label: Chat fade in Settings
items.discord_line: Do: open Settings and find the chat fade option. Turn it on if it is off, send a few chat lines, then wait. Pass: chat text fades after a short time, or you can clearly turn that fade on and off. If stuck: ask staff which Settings screen holds chat fade on this build.

items.label: Craft the same thing twice after you respawn
items.skip_rule: Skip if this live world has no forge you can use.
items.discord_line: Do: after you respawn, stand at a forge with enough materials for two of the same craft. Craft that recipe once, then craft it again. Pass: you keep both finished items in your inventory (nothing silently vanishes). If stuck: ask staff which simple recipe to use. Skip: use Skip if this live world has no forge.

items.label: Door tells you to apply on Discord
items.discord_line: Do: try to join with a Discord account that is not accepted yet (staff can hand you a test account if you do not have one). Pass: you see the apply message, and there is a working action that opens the Discord invite. If stuck: ask staff for an unaccepted test login; do not invent accounts.

items.label: Speaking light on the launcher
items.discord_line: Do: join voice the normal way through the launcher, then speak. Pass: the launcher shows a speaking light while you talk. This row is only that light, not any mark over your character's head. If stuck: confirm voice is connected in the launcher before you mark Fail.

items.label: Starting gold, player trade, no free extra gold
items.discord_line: Do three checks on a character: (1) starting gold is 40 the first time only; (2) trade gold with another player and both packs update; (3) trying to grab a second free starter purse, or gold from a craft that should not pay gold, fails with a clear error you can see. Pass: all three behave that way. Do not test buying from traders on this row. If stuck: ask staff for a second player or a safe craft that must not pay gold.

items.label: Refused craft keeps your materials
items.discord_line: Do: try a craft the game should refuse (staff will name one if you are unsure). Pass: your materials stay, and you see a clear reason it was refused. Do not mark Pass only because a recipe is hidden without a perk. If stuck: ask staff which refuse case to try on this live world.

items.label: K panel shows profession and half
items.discord_line: Do: open the K panel on a normal character made under the current rules (not an old leftover character unless staff says it is fine). Pass: you can see your profession and your half. If stuck: ask staff which character to use on this live world.
